main.description: Public purchasable unit referencing a parent product. Carries price (integer minor units), kind, public availability (never exposes counts), and present-but-dormant funding fields used by donation/membership kinds.

product.description: AT-URI of the parent shop.lgtm.commerce.product record.

kind.description: What this unit is. Drives the fulfillment family and which fields apply.

availability.description: Public purchasability signal derived from private stock. Never exposes exact counts.

pricing.description: Pricing mode. `fixed` uses `unitAmount` as the authoritative price. `pay_what_you_want` lets the buyer choose any amount at or above `minAmount`; `unitAmount` is the suggested amount. Price is always in the single native `currency`.

unitAmount.description: The price in integer minor units of `currency` under `fixed` pricing, or the suggested amount under `pay_what_you_want`. Authoritative in the single native `currency`.

minAmount.description: The floor amount in minor units; required under `pay_what_you_want` pricing. The buyer's chosen amount must be at or above this value.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code. All amounts (`unitAmount`, `minAmount`) are in this single native currency.

optionValues.description: Concrete option selections that identify this variant against the product's option axes.

recurringInterval.description: Billing interval for the membership kind. Present-but-dormant until funding ships.

benefits.description: Platform benefits granted on purchase/active membership (e.g. Discord role, GitHub team). Present-but-dormant until benefit providers ship.

digitalAssetKey.description: Opaque key identifying the gated digital asset (digital kind). Resolves to a short-lived signed download server-side; never a public URL.

optionValue.description: A selected value for one of the parent product's option axes.

name.description: Option axis name, matching a product option, e.g. "Size".

value.description: Selected value for that axis, e.g. "M".

benefit.description: A platform benefit to grant on purchase or active membership.

ref.description: Provider-specific benefit reference (e.g. Discord role id, GitHub team slug).
